messages:
Kai: quick idea — can we add a per-route transport toggle in the console so teams can canary grpc vs rest at route granularity? thinking model-routing experiments where some tenants try grpc and others stay on json.
Jordan: why per-route instead of per-service? ops complexity...
Kai: per-service is coarser; for model routes we want low-risk experiments. e.g., route /v1/generate/fast -> grpc for 10% tenants, rest stay on rest.
Maria: console UX: adding a toggle per route will explode the table. maybe a collapse panel and a single 'transport policy' column with a small pill: Auto / Forced(grpc) / Forced(rest) / Canary(%) 
Devin: quota + billing question — grpc payloads may be cheaper tokenwise but harder to attribute if we multiplex. we need per-transport cost breakdown in billing pipeline.
Olivia: telemetry-wise we need per-route, per-transport metrics: p50/p95 latency, token-cost, error-rate. sampling for traces. Prefer tags: route=..., transport=grpc|rest.
Maria: also rollouts UX: expose a canary slider (0-100%) and a dropdown who to include (all tenants, by org-id list, header-based). keep defaults off.
Jordan: fallback behavior? if grpc endpoint is unhealthy it should failover to rest automatically. that needs routing policy + health checks. prefer a priority list: [grpc, rest] with quick failover.
Kai: agree. tech notes: implement routing policy in the edge router (envoy plugin) or in our control-plane router? pros/cons? edge gives lower latency but harder to manage rollouts; control-plane is flexible but adds hop.
Devin: also need quotas enforced consistently — if grpc bypasses quota broker we double-charge. we must keep quota checks centralized (control-plane broker) and have edge call it synchronously or via token.
Olivia: sample config sketch:
```yaml
routes:
  - path: /v1/generate/fast
    transport_policy:
      mode: canary
      canary_pct: 10
      priority: [grpc, rest]
```
Kai: API to change canary from console should look like: POST /api/internal/routes/REPLACE/transport with body {"mode":"canary","canary_pct":20,"alloc":"org_id_list"} — ensure audit log.
Jordan: +1 to strong audit log and staged rollout API, and a dry-run flag for telemetry-only testing.
Maria: telemetry dashboard needs: transport_toggle_events, transport_shift_errors, per-route cost delta. add alert when cost delta > 15% or p95 regresses > 30%.
deploy-bot: :robot_face: canary toggle created for route /v1/generate/fast by Kai (canary_pct=10).
Kai: thanks — I'll write a short RFC with guardrails (quota path, observer-only mode, UI sketch). tagging @Maria for dashboard work and @Devin for quota implications. :thumbsup:
